Messages.Author: Molloy
Messages.Body:
Apparent Death
Action.
Only usable by a vampire in torpor. If the acting vampire is blocked, there is no combat. If the blocking is a vampire who can commit diablerie, that vampire may diablerize the acting vampire.
[for] +1 stealth action. The acting vampire leaves torpor.
[thn] -1 stealth action. Bleed. If the bleed is successful, burn this acting vampire at the end of the action.
[THN] Bleed.

Sabbat. Animals, Wraiths and Zombies Molloy recruits or employs get an additional life.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I like it very much. It's dangerous as hell, but gives Samedi an unexpected weapon.
I'm a bit concerned by the "burn this acting vampire at the end of the action." part at thn because I sense there may be a trick with a turbo-baron kind of stuff.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Molloy
Messages.Body:
"I'm a bit concerned by the "burn this acting vampire at the end of the action." part at thn because I sense there may be a trick with a turbo-baron kind of stuff."

I know what you mean, but removing the vampire from the game (which I thought about) would be too big a penalty. The -1 stealth and the need to be in torpor should be enough to make this ineffective for turbo-strategies, shouldn't it?

Sabbat. Animals, Wraiths and Zombies Molloy recruits or employs get an additional life.

I don't know if this has a big impact or not in fact.
